title: Enterprise Knowledge Ontology (EKO) and the Corpus Readiness Index
description: An open vocabulary, a machine-checkable publish gate, and a measurement instrument for organisational knowledge in the age of retrieval. EKO formalises the distinction between a working document and an authoritative knowledge asset as a maintenance commitment with its own lifecycle, enforced by a SHACL publish gate runnable in CI, and the Corpus Readiness Index scores a corpus across seven dimensions by geometric mean. The repository includes a real study of 54,222 GOV.UK guidance documents in which zero of 300 sampled documents carried any machine-readable maintenance-commitment field. Ontology, shapes and vocabularies are CC BY 4.0; code is MIT.
